get_language with empty string returns an error

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { getLanguage } from "@xberg-io/tree-sitter-language-pack";
function main() {
try {
    getLanguage("");
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof Error) {
      console.error(`${error.name}: ${error.message}`);
    }
  }
}

void main();
```
